lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher introduces the specific real-world Sri Lankan dilemma for 'Explains how sustainable peace brings about the national development: Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency Level 8.3.3', presents concrete inquiry task cards/materials derived from the textbook/TIG, and organizes student teams with assigned roles. Students examine the prompt, divide responsibilities, and formulate inquiry questions.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Inquiry task cards/materials, textbook/TIG, student roles badges
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Teacher formatively checks team role allocation and student understanding of inquiry prompts on 'Explains how sustainable peace brings about the national development'.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher circulates across 8 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students actively carry out Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency Level 8.3.3, working in teams to analyze real-world civic situations related to 'Explains how sustainable peace brings about the national development' and co-create their group findings without passive bystanders.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Worksheets and activity cards for Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency Level 8.3.3, chart paper, markers
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Teacher observes team collaboration and checks evidence use and task cards for Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency Level 8.3.3.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher synthesizes discoveries against the learning outcomes.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Group spokespersons present discoveries or co-created artifacts; peer teams evaluate using criteria and offer feedback.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Peer teams evaluate spokesperson presentations against criteria and provide constructive feedback on 'Explains how sustainable peace brings about the national development'.
